name: TeamWar
mechanic: Pick red or blue. Each week the team that trades more ETH takes the losing team's pot.
plain: A weekly team game for ETH pools. Join red or blue with joinTeam(). Every trade you make then pays 0.25% of its ETH side into your team's pot and adds to your team's weekly volume. When the week ends (Monday 00:00 UTC), the team with more volume splits both pots, shared by how much each member traded. A tie gives each team its own pot back. Players who never join trade normally and pay no game fee.
rules: Join a team per pool with joinTeam(); switching takes effect the next week.
A member's swap pays 0.25% of its ETH side into their team's weekly pot and adds its ETH size to the team's volume.
After Monday 00:00 UTC the higher-volume team splits both pots by member volume; a tie returns each team its own pot.
Non-members pay no game fee; claims are pull-only per (pool, week) via claim().

fee.note: 0.25% of the ETH side into your team's pot, members only
